claim.name: Ananya Iyer
claim.description: AquaPure RO water purifier stopped dispensing water and is leaking from the base. Red E2 error light is on. The unit has not been moved since installation.

fields.location: Flat 3B, 14 Gandhi Nagar 2nd Main Road, Adyar, Chennai 600020
fields.description: Purifier not dispensing water, leaking from the base

submitted_documents.description: Water pooled under the unit. Red E2 error light lit on the front panel. Outer casing intact, no cracks or impact marks.
Close-up of the base: drip from the inlet solenoid valve connector. Warranty seal on the service panel intact.

submitted_documents.summary: Job sheet JS-2026-10-23-0912. Visit on 23 Oct 2026. Diagnosis: RO booster pump failed (no pressure); inlet solenoid valve leaking. No signs of impact, warranty seal intact, installed in a residence. Serial number matches the invoice. Recommended: replace pump and valve.
